name: Read the Surface
summary: Watch a thing until the last hands that held it give themselves away.
flavour: You look, and keep looking past the point where looking is polite, and the object begins to volunteer things about the person who set it down.

name: Peripheral Sense
summary: You notice being watched before you notice noticing.
flavour: Attention has a weight to it. You have started to feel where it is coming from.

name: Compose Yourself
summary: Put your own face back on from the inside.
flavour: You watch yourself the way you would watch a stranger, and the shaking stops being yours.

name: Keep Watching
summary: Sit with the role until it stops being a costume — the acting method, done on purpose.
flavour: A Spectator digests by observing. You spend the evening in a coffee house saying nothing at all, and it settles a little further in.

name: Surface Thought
summary: Catch the sentence a person decided not to say.
flavour: It arrives in your own voice, which is the part nobody warns you about.

name: Look Elsewhere
summary: Put the idea of somewhere else into the heads around you, and walk out through it.
flavour: Every eye in the room turns to the door you are not using.

name: Unremarkable
summary: Be the kind of person nobody bothers to describe afterwards.
flavour: You are not invisible. You are simply not worth the effort of remembering, which works better.

name: Count the Exits
summary: Read a room for the thing in it that means you harm.
flavour: Nine people, four of them armed, one of them here for you. You could not say how you know the fourth part.

name: Consulting Manner
summary: Ask in the tone that people answer without deciding to.
flavour: You do not raise your voice. You have never had to. They hear a doctor and they start explaining themselves.

name: Misplace the Thought
summary: Suggest to a lock's owner that they left it open, and to yourself that you belong here.
flavour: Nothing is forced. The man with the key simply cannot recall a reason to keep it, and is faintly embarrassed about it later.

name: Bedside Calm
summary: Treat your own mind the way you would treat a patient's.
flavour: You take yourself apart carefully, note what is inflamed, and put it back in a better order.

name: Borrowed Certainty
summary: Hand a person a conviction and let them believe they arrived at it.
flavour: They will defend it to you afterwards, warmly, as their own idea.

name: Not Here
summary: Occupy the blind spot in every head in the room at once.
flavour: You walk out between two men who are looking directly at the space you are in.

name: Wear Their Expectation
summary: Be whoever the room was already waiting for.
flavour: You do not choose the face. They do, and you agree to it.
